entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: Plane home to Otaria, Yavimaya, Shiv, Rath and many peoples.

entities.name: Rath
entities.description: Plane of the Death Pits and the Furnace of Rath.

entities.name: Volrath
entities.description: Speaker on mental attacks and the unrestfulness of sleep.

entities.name: Crovax
entities.description: An ascendant evincar who speaks of bonds of loyalty tying one to the grave.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: A silver golem who tells of a wise woman and her book.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Artificer who in his apprenticeship improved the Thran's ornithopter.

entities.name: Barrin
entities.description: A master wizard proud of his apprentice.

entities.name: Braids
entities.description: A cruel figure who raises an army of nightmares and extorts.

entities.name: Toren
entities.description: A man embarrassed to be stepped on by a bug.

entities.name: Numsgil
entities.description: Goblin who became king by killing Blog and his predecessors.

entities.name: Taseen
entities.description: An elvish bard who survived a kavu ambush.

entities.name: Handel
entities.description: Infantry soldier who praises an orator.

entities.name: Serra
entities.description: Source of the teaching 'Believe in the ideal, not the idol.'

entities.name: Memnarch
entities.description: Being who separated the Ur-Golem's eye from its body.

entities.name: Cabal Patriarch
entities.description: A Cabal leader who scorns dying for honor.

entities.name: Oracle en-Vec
entities.description: An oracle who hears a red wave.

entities.name: Fyndhorn elder
entities.description: A Fyndhorn elder who describes the Verduran Enchantress.

events.summary: Volrath boasts that mental attacks leave victims no memory.
events.quote: The beauty of mental attacks is that your victims never remember them.

events.summary: Crovax declares the bonds of loyalty can tie one to the grave.
events.quote: The bonds of loyalty can tie one to the grave.

events.summary: Gerrard tells a foe they will tire before their pain does.
events.quote: You can run from your pain, but you will tire before it does.

events.summary: Kamahl states he has seen life's purpose.
events.quote: I have seen life's purpose, and now it is my own.

events.summary: Urza reflects on improving the Thran's original ornithopter design as an apprentice.
events.quote: It has been my honor to improve on the Thran's original design.

events.summary: Barrin's pride in his apprentice is diminished when he must retrieve the other students from levitation.
events.quote: Barrin's pride in his apprentice was diminished somewhat when he had to get the others back down.

events.summary: Mayvar threatens to claim a victim's blood, marrow and spirit.
events.quote: Your blood, your marrow, your spirit—all are mine.

events.summary: Braids finds time for petty extortion amid killing peasants and raising an army of nightmares.
events.quote: Braids somehow found time for her favorite hobby: petty extortion.

events.summary: Numsgil becomes goblin king by killing Blog, continuing a chain of regicide.
events.quote: To be king, Numsgil did in Blog, who did in Unkful

events.summary: Toren is stepped on by a bug.
events.quote: Toren had stepped on a lot of bugs during his life

events.summary: General Khurzog responds to threats to his men.
events.quote: So they want to kill my men? Well two can play at that game.

events.summary: Dravus mocks those who consider all options before acting.
events.quote: While those people are considering all the options, that's usually when I kill them.

events.summary: Kaervek declares that the weak should be killed or ignored.
events.quote: If it is weak, either kill it or ignore it.

events.summary: Taseen recounts death descending from the trees in a kavu attack.
events.quote: Our party had no chance as death descended from above.

events.summary: Torgle gloats after a boat sinks.
events.quote: Who's the crazy one now!?

events.summary: Remin warns that darkness hides what should be feared.
events.quote: Don't fear the darkness. Fear what it hides.

events.summary: Tender-Hand says healing cannot restore hope.
events.quote: But I cannot restore their hope.

events.summary: Memnarch separated the Ur-Golem's eye from its body.
events.quote: It still stares accusingly at Memnarch, though millennia have passed since he separated the eye from its body.

events.summary: Serra's teaching: believe in the ideal, not the idol.
events.quote: Believe in the ideal, not the idol.

events.summary: Ib Halfheart panics about a blinking spirit.
events.quote: Don't look at it! Maybe it'll go away!

events.summary: Karn tells of a wise woman who wrote in white ink once the pages were black.
events.quote: Everything the wise woman learned she wrote in a book

events.summary: Mairsil asks what others have that he cannot obtain.
events.quote: What do you have that I cannot obtain?

events.summary: Cabal Patriarch scorns dying for honor.
events.quote: Any fool who would die for honor is better off dead.
